title: Model Action Response
description: Per-step decisions returned by a model service to the Simulation Manager. Returned by /predict.

session_id.description: Must echo the session_id from the request

step.description: Must echo the step from the request

actions.description: Map of TLS id → action. May be a subset of all TLS — Manager applies default control to omitted ones.

BinarySwitch.title: Binary Switch Action
BinarySwitch.description: Keep current phase or advance to next green. Used by GNN. Manager auto-handles yellow transition.

value.description: 0 = keep current phase, 1 = advance to next green

SetPhase.title: Set Phase Action
SetPhase.description: Set TLS to a specific phase index. Used by MPC. Manager auto-handles yellow transition if needed.

value.description: Target phase index in this TLS's program

SetDuration.title: Set Duration Action
SetDuration.description: Set a phase to run for a specific duration in seconds. Used by cycle-based controllers.

phase.description: Phase index whose duration is being set

Telemetry.description: Optional model-emitted telemetry. Forwarded to the Dashboard verbatim.

inference_time_ms.description: Wall-clock time spent computing the response

layer_activations.description: Per-layer per-node mean activation magnitudes (visualization aid)

model_specific.description: Free-form payload for any extra data a model wants to surface to the Dashboard
